text:
nina (PM): Quick thread for Customer Vega pilot acceptance criteria + cross-team gates. Need a tight checklist before we flip prod org.

leo (Eng Runtime): Runtime checklist: model pin + quant profile, canary rollout (5% -> 20% -> 100%), deterministic seed for evals. Need infra to expose prewarm API.

jamal (Infra): Prewarm API coming. We need stable instance types (H100 req by customer) and a reserved burst pool. Also need a maintenance window for initial load test. Proposed window: Sat 0300-0600 UTC. OK?

anya (Security): H100 ok but we need HSM connectivity tested. Also require per-tenant VPC peering + customer IP ranges. Will need to approve IAM roles and secrets rotation policy.

casey (SRE): SLOs to propose: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 300ms. Alerting: page on p95 breach > 5mins or error-rate > 1%. We need runbook and rollback play for traffic split rollback.

soph (DevEx): I'll build a one-page runbook + a short CLI script for safe rollback: `rictl traffic set --route vega --percent 0`. Will also include eval prompts and sample curl. Draft tomorrow.

nina (PM): Customer asks for cost cap alerts and telemetry: cost burn > $X/day -> notify product + customer. Who can wire cost metrics?

jamal (Infra): Infra can emit cost metrics to internal metricking. Need mapping of token units -> cost per model variant from Product.

leo (Eng Runtime): We'll include model-tagging so metrics map correctly. Also adding a KV cache warm path for common prompts to reduce token usage.

anya (Security): Also require data residency clause in the pilot contract (EU region). Legal wants exact retention numbers for logs and eval traces.

legal-bot: Flag: contract amendment required for data retention and audit access. Nina to coordinate with Sales & Legal.

casey (SRE): For safety, propose automatic fallback to hosted read-only endpoint if latency spike > threshold or error percentage rises. Define threshold?

nina (PM): Suggest failover trigger: p95 > 350ms for 3 consecutive 1-min windows OR error rate > 2% for 2mins. If agreed we document in runbook.

leo (Eng Runtime): Agreed. Will implement routing rule + metrics. Need infra labels for canary nodes (e.g., `vega-canary=true`).

jamal (Infra): Done. I'll add node labels and prewarm hooks. Capacity reservation ETA: Tue COB. Need signoff from Security on IP ranges and HSM endpoint.

anya (Security): I'll validate IP ranges by Mon, HSM test scheduled Tue. Also: audit retention: 400 days.

nina (PM): Action list: 1) Leo: canary routing + KV warm path (due Thu). 2) Jamal: reserve H100 burst pool + node labels (due Tue). 3) Anya: HSM + IP signoff + retention (due Tue). 4) Casey: runbook & rollback steps + alert thresholds (due Wed). 5) Soph: playbook + CLI snippets (due Wed). 6) Legal: contract amendment (owner legal-bot) pinged.

deploy-bot: Thread created by nina (PM)  1849991234

leo (Eng Runtime): Starting a PR for routing; will include sample YAML for the canary policy.

jamal (Infra): Capacity PO in flight and ticket `INF-8272` created, tagged `vega-pilot`.

anya (Security): Uploaded HSM test plan to the ticket. Will post results here once green.

soph (DevEx): I'll drop the first version of the playbook in #devex-docs by EOD tomorrow.

nina (PM): Thank you all. We'll do a 15m async check Mon 10am PT to validate green items before customer smoke test. Ping me if anything blocks.
